notes: Signals the Deal Finder flags on every property. Labels and descriptions are shown to users as-is, so keep them plain English. Weights are used by Phase 2 scoring only. 'source' points at docs/field-map.md.

signals.label: Pre-foreclosure
signals.description: The lender has started foreclosure (notice of default or lis pendens is on record).

signals.label: Owner passed away / probate
signals.description: The owner is deceased or the property is in probate.

signals.label: Divorce filing
signals.description: The owners have a divorce on record.

signals.label: Bankruptcy
signals.description: An owner has filed for bankruptcy.

signals.label: Liens on the property
signals.description: There are recorded liens (for example a contractor, city, or tax lien).

signals.label: Looks vacant
signals.description: Mail is not being delivered — the property appears empty.

signals.label: Owner doesn't live there
signals.description: The owner's mailing address is different from the property.

signals.label: Owner lives out of state
signals.description: The owner's mailing address is outside Illinois.

signals.label: High equity (50%+)
signals.description: The owner owns at least half the home's value outright.

signals.label: Owned 15+ years
signals.description: The same owner has held it for at least 15 years.
